baseline_map_for_aggregate_suite.note: Pass directly as aggregate_suite(readings, baseline=...). None means ABSENT; aggregate_suite reports those under baseline_absent.

payload.comparison_rule: COMPOSE runs prescreen=false. Only regimes.no_prescreen is a valid comparator. regimes.prescreened is retained solely so that a substitution is visible, and must never be used as a target.

metric.budget_warning: A 250-call or 1,000-call COMPOSE reading is a DIFFERENT metric (auc_top10@250 / auc_top10@1000) and is not comparable to any value here.
metric.dispersion: population standard deviation (ddof=0) over the 3 runs

payload.purpose: Authoritative, regime-separated PMO baseline values with per-value provenance. Research record only: authorizes nothing.

no_prescreen.description: No ZINC250k prescreen. Reproduce command in the archive README runs with --max_oracle_calls 10000 and WITHOUT --use_prescreen.

prescreened.description: ZINC250k prescreened. Reproduce command in the archive README adds --use_prescreen; the initial population is read from a per-task oracle-scored ZINC250k csv and those scores never enter mol_buffer, so they are not charged against the 10,000-call budget.
prescreened.do_not_compare: NOT a comparator for a prescreen=false run.
